scientific_integrity: Combinatorial proof with standalone reproducibility checks, no external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labelled outer-independent Roman functions on two-factor complete Cartesian products; total version has an explicit four-cycle exception. Scalar minimum was previously known. Priority not independently established; full access to one background article was limited. Finite checks are not an infinite proof.
title: Exact outer-independent Roman weight enumerators and minimum-function multiplicities on rook graphs
